Comment: Diagnose lock_factory config error in Moodle

commands: grep -n 'lock_factory\|lock_' /var/www/moodledata/config.php 2>/dev/null || grep -n 'lock_factory\|lock_' /app/moodledata/config.php 2>/dev/null || echo 'config.php not in standard location'
echo '=== Check if lock factory class exists ==='
find /app/moodle /var/www/html/moodle -name '*.php' 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -l "class $LOCK_CLASS" 2>/dev/null | head -3 || echo 'Class file not found'
echo '=== Recent PHP error log (lock errors) ==='
grep -i 'lock.*factory\|factory.*not.*exist\|lock_factory' /var/log/php-fpm/error.log /var/log/httpd/error_log /tmp/php-error.log 2>/dev/null | tail -20 || echo 'No matching log entries'
